# Berlin Heating Repair Request

A professional, firm email draft you can send to your landlord. It asks for repair within 7 days, requests written confirmation, and keeps the tone respectful.

# Landlord Email Draft

**Subject:** Request for urgent heating repair and written confirmation

Dear [Landlord Name],

I am writing to follow up on the heating issue in my one-bedroom apartment in Berlin. The heating has not worked properly since **2026-01-08**, and I reported the problem on **2026-01-10**. I have not yet received a response.

As the issue remains unresolved, I kindly request that the heating be repaired within **7 days** of this email. Please also provide **written confirmation** that you have received this message and that repair arrangements are being made.

Because heating is essential, I would appreciate prompt attention to this matter. If you need access to the apartment to inspect or repair the system, please let me know a suitable time.

Thank you for your immediate attention. I look forward to your written response.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email Address]

# Evidence Checklist

Keep these records in case you need to follow up further:

- Copy of the original repair report from **2026-01-10**
- Photos or short videos showing the heating problem
- Temperature notes for the apartment, if available
- Any emails, messages, or letters sent to the landlord
- Proof of delivery or read receipt, if you have it
- Dates and times of any attempted visits, calls, or maintenance contact
- Receipts for any extra heating costs, if applicable

# Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy Email] https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+copy+text+in+email+client

# Sources

- Berlin tenant information: https://www.berlin.de/sen/wohnen/mietrecht/
- German Civil Code overview: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/englisch_bgb/
